instruction: How long is my longest Spotify playlist, in minutes, rounded to the nearest number?
notes: Read-only information-gathering task (evaluation requires no DB changes), so all Spotify actions only assert knowledge predicates. The supervisor's email (Spotify username) comes from supervisor.show_profile (modeled as static username-for plus the profile-known effect), the password from show_account_passwords. The real number of playlists/songs is unknown at modeling time, so the problem uses placeholder objects (2 playlists x 2 songs); show_playlist_library makes the library listed, show_playlist lists a playlist's songs, show_song reveals a song's duration. To force every song of every playlist to be inspected without quantified goals or conditional effects, songs are chained with the static next-item relation and the knowledge cursor predicate (unlocked ?x): inspecting a song unlocks the next item, and the last song unlocks the answer object minutes-answer, which is exactly the condition under which the longest playlist length can be computed (round(max sum(duration)/60)). supervisor-complete-task takes the answer object, requires (unlocked minutes-answer), and is the only action setting (task-completed). page_index of show_playlist_library is left as an agent-side pagination detail.
